title: Rioproperty logos
description: A centred violet capital line over a single row of light-grey client marks that runs off both edges of the page. The row fades in as it enters and drifts sideways with the scroll (not on a clock); each mark turns violet on hover. The line's words ripple up out of masks.
notes: names render as plain text marks, alternating the display and body faces; swap in real logos by editing the item
the list repeats (repeat) so the row always covers the window
name: rioproperty-logos

props.name: heading
props.description: the centred violet capital line above the row

props.name: names
props.description: client names, shown as plain-text marks in light grey (a real logo can replace each later)

props.name: repeat
props.description: how many times the list repeats so the row always runs past both edges
